subject: Learning Methods
title: The Testing Effect
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Testing Effect usable.

hook.text: Students who tested themselves remembered 50% more a week later than those who reread the same material.

buildup.text: Testing is not just assessment. It is one of the most powerful learning strategies ever discovered.

discovery.text: Retrieving a memory strengthens the retrieval pathway itself. The act of remembering makes remembering easier.

twist.text: Rereading creates an illusion of fluency. You recognize the words and mistake familiarity for knowledge.

climax.text: Close the book. Quiz yourself. The struggle to retrieve is precisely what makes the memory stronger.

punchline.text: Test yourself to learn. Not just to measure.

quiz.question: Why does self-testing improve memory more than rereading?
options: Testing takes less time than rereading
Retrieving a memory strengthens the retrieval pathway
Tests create anxiety which aids memory
